why: YAI4Edu is a named software pipeline that converts static e-books into interactive intelligent textbooks, rather than a general instructional element.
name: YAI4Edu
product_description: YAI4Edu is an open-source software pipeline developed by Francesco Sovrano and colleagues that transforms PDF, XML, or HTML educational texts into interactive textbooks with clickable glosses, overviews, and open-ended question answering.
